name: bt9-android-deploy
title: Build targets stage 9: Android signing, AAB, device selection, install and run, logcat into the editor
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 9 of section 5.
acceptance: Release AAB signed from a user-local keystore reference; debug APK signed with a debug key
n2build run installs on a chosen device and streams the game's log as JSON lines the editor shows
The frontend's device picker and log view work against it (a small frontend item if the panel needs changes)
gate: needs the user's go; depends on bt7-fe-build-settings and bt8-android-player
notes: Reviewer: keystore passwords never on a command line, in logs or in the project.
